svg.text: ▸ Rob takes his own life — the strand ends
▸ her mother stops speaking — the strand breaks
STRANDS — the two leads are the two saturated lanes
Normal People — the braid, vertical (panel B of 2)
Episode 7 to the coda. The separated years.
Every lane that pulls away from the centre is a person one of them chose instead.
At the coda the two leads fade outward, in opposite directions, and stop. The braid does not resolve.
